notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata extraction exists but requires an explicit Fetch action rather than occurring automatically on save.
REF-BM-10: The tag-entry field has no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: Search supports tag: syntax, not the required #tag syntax.
REF-BM-20: Bulk remove-tag exists server-side but is not exposed through the multi-selection UI.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written but are not rendered as Markdown when viewed.
REF-BM-24: HTML and screenshot capture exists, but the HTML is not self-contained and PDF URLs are not downloaded and stored as PDFs.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape import preserves titles and tags but ignores ADD_DATE.
REF-BM-32: Default sort and font size are configurable, but displayed-item settings are missing.
